title: Initialize Visited Set
description: Create a set or boolean array to track which nodes have been visited. Mark the source node as visited and begin the recursive exploration from it.

title: Process Current Node (Pre-Visit)
description: Perform any operation on the current node before exploring its neighbors. Common operations: record discovery time, add to topological order, check if target reached.

title: Recursively Explore Unvisited Neighbors
description: For each neighbor of the current node: if it has NOT been visited, recursively apply DFS to that neighbor. The recursion goes deep into the graph before backtracking — hence 'depth-first'.

title: Backtrack When Stuck
description: When a node has no unvisited neighbors, the recursive call returns to the previous node (backtracking). This is the natural unwinding of the recursion stack.

title: Process Current Node (Post-Visit)
description: After all neighbors are explored, perform post-visit operations. Common: record finishing time (for topological sort), add to connected component list, check back edges for cycle detection.

title: Repeat for All Components
description: After DFS from source completes, iterate over all nodes. If any node remains unvisited, start a new DFS from it. This ensures all connected components are explored.
